name: myhive-travel-app-dev
description: Local dev orchestrator — boots backend + frontend + Stripe webhook listener with one command.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n be,fe,stripe -c blue,green,magenta "cd myhive-backend && gradlew bootRun --args=--spring.profiles.active=dev" "cd myhive-react-app && npm start" "stripe listen --forward-to localhost:8080/payments/webhook"
